description: The PROPERTY data-description clause (ISO 13.18.42) - introduced 2002 (OO). {is2002()}?-gated in dataDescriptionClause plus the valueItem loop guard (at 2002+ PROPERTY is reserved (8.9) so it terminates a VALUE clause instead of parsing as a constant-name operand); accessors synthesize per GR1/GR2 under the pinned __GET_/__SET_ names (11.7.4 GR1a). Below 2002 the W1.5 parse-layer mapping names the edition (0900). The sample writes the clause where 13.18.42.3 SR1 permits it - the working-storage section of an instance definition (kb/Work PB1273: a PROPERTY clause in a program is COBOL2563).
vcr: M2 OO (roadmap Phase 3); W1.5 parse-layer mapping (DEVLOG 606)
